PRODUCT OVERVIEW

An integrated foundation.

Avarthana's phased-array Versal RFSoC transmit/receive platform integrates a 4 x 4 cavity-backed patch sub-array with RF front-end electronics and an acquisition interface. Low-noise amplification, filtering and adjustable gain are packaged beneath the antenna using an RFSiP or equivalent implementation. The Versal RFSoC acquisition architecture provides a configurable path into the radar processing system. Antenna band, conversion channels and transmit characteristics are defined for each application.

Integrated sub-array: 4 x 4 cavity-backed patch arrangement with sixteen antenna elements.

RF front-end integration: LNA, filtering and gain functions packaged with the antenna assembly.

Adjustable receive gain: 65 +/-15 dB receive-gain target with 1 dB adjustment steps.

Low-noise receive path: Approximately 1 dB noise-figure target for the RF front-end design.

RF acquisition interface: Versal RFSoC architecture selected for the required radar signal chain.

Compact packaging: RFSiP or equivalent electronics integrated beneath the antenna.
